_provenance.source: ClinVar esummary (canonical_spdi, variation_loc) + Ensembl REST sequence/region (GRCh38 and GRCh37) via GEPER's SequenceContextGenerator
_provenance.selection: the nine records the C1 audit found normalised into a different variant, plus BRCA1/BRCA2 deletion/duplication/insertion records (<=9 bp) up to 40 per gene
_provenance.input_form: VCF-style variant built from canonical_spdi (anchor base from the reference where the SPDI allele is bare)
_provenance.windows: +/-250 bp around the variant; coordinates are 1-based, inclusive
